subject: general
question:
Refer to the given number series and answer the question that follows. (All numbers are single-digit numbers only.) (Counting to be done from left to right only.)

(Left) 1 8 9 1 3 8 3 8 9 9 5 9 6 5 5 1 7 7 4 2 3 1 6 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 1 8 9 1 3 8 3 8 9 9 5 9 6 5 5 1 7 7 4 2 3 1 6 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Even

(Left) 1 8 9 1 3 8 3 8 9 9 5 9 6 5 5 1 7 7 4 2 3 1 6 (Right)

Thus, there is no even number, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
